text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, while I'm out with Tokai Teio...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Claw machines! Don't they look fun?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, and that one's filled with plush
Cuties!
They're super popular right now!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio points toward a claw machine
filled
with Umamusume plushies.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Heh, truth be told, I don't just shine at
arcade
dancing games. I'm incredible at
these too!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
What about you? Are you any good at
claw
machines?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Really? All right then, let's see what you
got!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's no way I can fail now!
